source_caption:
📺 Game of Thrones (2011–2019)

Game of Thrones follows powerful noble families battling for control of the Iron Throne and the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros. As the Stark, Lannister, and Targaryen families fight for power, political alliances, shocking betrayals, and deadly rivalries threaten to tear the kingdom apart. Meanwhile, Daenerys Targaryen rises from exile with dreams of reclaiming her family’s throne, while Jon Snow faces growing dangers beyond the Wall, where an ancient supernatural threat threatens all of humanity. With dragons, massive battles, unexpected deaths, and unforgettable characters, the struggle for power becomes increasingly dangerous as enemies emerge from every direction. Combining epic fantasy, political intrigue, emotional storytelling, and breathtaking action, the series explores loyalty, ambition, family, betrayal, and the devastating cost of power.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Drama • Action • Adventure

⭐ IMDb: 9.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~50–80 minutes per episode • 8 seasons • 73 episodes

🎥 Creators: David Benioff and D. B. Weiss

🏆 Recognition: Based on George R. R. Martin’s A Song of Ice and Fire novels, the series won 59 Primetime Emmy Awards, including four for Outstanding Drama Series. It became one of the most influential television shows in history and inspired the prequel series House of the Dragon.

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max • Amazon Prime Video • Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Game of Thrones is an American fantasy drama television series created by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss for HBO. It is the first adaptation of A Song of Ice and Fire, a series of high fantasy novels by George R. R. Martin, and the first in what would become the Game of Thrones franchise. The show premiered on HBO in the United States on April 17, 2011, and concluded on May 19, 2019, with 73 episodes broadcast over eight seasons. Set on the fictional continents of Westeros and Essos, Game of Thrones has a large ensemble cast and follows several story arcs throughout the course of the show.
